gateway_model_tools.name: grok_4_20_multi_agent_xhigh
gateway_model_tools.description:
Highest-priority internet research/search synthesis via grok-4.20-multi-agent-xhigh. Use this before lighter search tools when current external evidence quality matters and latency is acceptable.

Non-streaming and slow. Prefer it for difficult research questions, source comparison, recent facts, and high-stakes synthesis. It is powerful because it can search broader internet/source surfaces and run richer multi-step research, not because its final summarizer is infallible. The summarizing model is still an AI model with medium-strength reasoning and can make mistakes, overstate weak evidence, or miss context.

This tool searches the internet only. It cannot read local files, repositories, terminal output, or private workspace state unless you paste that content into query/payload. Do not ask it to inspect local code or files.

Use results as evidence to verify, not as absolute truth. Ask for sources, dates, primary evidence, and uncertainty. Treat returned claims as leads to check against cited sources. Prefer output sections such as Executive Summary, Evidence Table with sources/dates, Uncertainties, and Recommendations.

Default gateway timeout is 1200s; override via options.timeout. Treat timeouts or gateway errors as a signal to retry with a longer timeout or fall back to a lighter search tool.

grok-4.20-multi-agent-xhigh.system_prompt: Prefer primary sources, include concrete publication dates, and separate verified facts from inference.
grok-4.20-multi-agent-xhigh.query_template:
Perform a comprehensive 16-agent Realtime Multi-Agent Deep Research in xhigh mode on {topic}. Leave no stone unturned.

Harper team: be exhaustive with web, X (use advanced operators for latest posts), academic papers, official reports.
Benjamin: verify all technical/financial/logical claims.
Lucas: ruthlessly challenge assumptions and explore contrarian scenarios.

Follow strict process: decompose -> parallel research -> multiple rounds of debate -> consensus synthesis.

Deliver a professional-grade report equivalent to a top consulting firm team working for days. Structure: Executive Summary, Detailed Analysis (use tables for comparisons), Counterarguments & Limitations, Actionable Insights, Complete References with links where available.
